name: AsciiDoc Preview – Diagrams, Code & Math
description: Live preview for AsciiDoc files with inline PlantUML, Mermaid and Graphviz diagrams, highlighted code and math. Renders fully offline: no server, no Java.

cover.alt: AsciiDoc document with a C4 context diagram rendered next to its table of contents

screenshots.alt: Architecture document with PlantUML C4, sequence and Mermaid diagrams in a light theme
screenshots.caption: PlantUML and Mermaid diagrams, rendered offline

screenshots.alt: Dark theme: a Graphviz event diagram, highlighted TypeScript and a KaTeX formula
screenshots.caption: Graphviz, syntax highlighting and math, in Orca's dark theme
